parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
animate[ænamit]adj.
When something is animate, it has life.
Khi thứ gì đó có sự sống, nó có sự sống. (animate: có sự sống)
➔ Rocks and machines are not animate things.
2
classify[klæsəfai]v.
To classify things is to put them into groups based on their type.
Phân loại các vật là đặt chúng vào các nhóm dựa trên loại của chúng. (classify: phân loại)
➔ The biologist classified the plant as a completely new species.
3
concede[kənsiːd]v.
To concede is to admit that something is true against your wish.
Thừa nhận là chấp nhận điều gì đó là sự thật trái với mong muốn của bạn. (concede: thừa nhận)
➔ The student conceded that he had cheated on the test.
4
concept[kɑnsept]n.
A concept is an idea about something.
Khái niệm là một ý tưởng về điều gì đó. (concept: khái niệm)
➔ I learned some concepts of molecules before working in the science lab.
5
construct[kənstrʌkt]v.
To construct something means to make or build it.
Xây dựng cái gì đó có nghĩa là làm hoặc tạo ra nó. (construct: xây dựng)
➔ The men used wood and metal to construct a house.
6
decade[dekeid]n.
A decade is a period of ten years.
Thập kỷ là khoảng thời gian mười năm. (decade: thập kỷ)
➔ She celebrated her three decades of work with the company.
7
diagram[daiəgræm]n.
A diagram is a simple drawing that explains what something is or how it works.
Biểu đồ là một bản vẽ đơn giản giải thích điều gì đó là gì hoặc nó hoạt động như thế nào. (diagram: biểu đồ)
➔ By following the diagram, I was able to put the desk together.
8
ferry[feri]n.
A ferry is a boat that carries passengers over short distances.
Phà là một con thuyền chở hành khách qua những khoảng cách ngắn. (ferry: phà)
➔ The ferry took the people across the lake.
9
handy[hændi]adj.
If something is handy, it is useful.
Nếu thứ gì đó tiện dụng, nó hữu ích. (handy: tiện dụng, hữu ích)
➔ An eraser is handy if you make a lot of mistakes.
10
isolate[aisəleit]v.
To isolate is to separate one person or thing from a group.
Cách ly là tách một người hoặc vật ra khỏi nhóm. (isolate: cách ly)
➔ The teacher isolated the bad child from the class before talking with her.
11
longing[lɔ(:)ŋiŋ]n.
A longing is a strong feeling of wanting.
Sự khao khát là một cảm giác mong muốn mãnh liệt. (longing: khao khát)
➔ Since he skipped breakfast, he had a longing for food all morning.
12
numerous[nju:mərəs]adj.
If something is numerous, there are many of those things.
Nếu có nhiều thứ gì đó, thì có rất nhiều thứ đó. (numerous: nhiều)
➔ It was hard to drive fast since there were numerous holes in the road.
13
particle[pɑ:rtikl]n.
A particle is a very small piece of something.
Hạt là một mẩu rất nhỏ của thứ gì đó. (particle: hạt)
➔ The bottles of wine were covered in a layer of dust particles.
14
plea[pli:]n.
A plea is a request that is urgent or emotional.
Lời cầu xin là một yêu cầu khẩn cấp hoặc đầy cảm xúc. (plea: lời cầu xin)
➔ The poor, hungry man made a plea for food.
15
refrain[rifrein]v.
To refrain from something is to avoid doing it.
Kiềm chế làm gì đó là tránh làm nó. (refrain: kìm nén)
➔ The doctor asked Mary to refrain from eating fast food as part of her diet.
16
review[rivju:]n.
A review of something is a formal inspection of it by people in authority.
Sự đánh giá điều gì đó là sự kiểm tra chính thức của nó bởi những người có thẩm quyền. (review: sự xem xét, duyệt lại)
➔ The government ordered a careful review of the economic situation.
17
sophisticated[səfistikeitid]adj.
If someone is sophisticated, they know many things about the world.
Nếu ai đó tinh vi, họ biết nhiều điều về thế giới. (sophisticated: sành sỏi, tinh vi)
➔ Jake is one of the most sophisticated persons I've ever met.
18
surrender[sərendər]v.
To surrender something is to give it up.
Đầu hàng thứ gì đó là từ bỏ nó. (surrender: từ bỏ, đầu hàng)
➔ The thief surrendered the money to the police when he was caught.
19
upright[ʌprait]adj.
If something is upright, it is standing up straight.
Nếu thứ gì đó thẳng đứng, nó đang đứng thẳng. (upright: thẳng đứng)
➔ Meerkats can't walk like humans, but they can stand upright.
20
worthwhile[wə:rθwail]adj.
If something is worthwhile, it is important or useful.
Nếu điều gì đó đáng giá, nó quan trọng hoặc hữu ích. (worthwhile: đáng giá)
➔ On his visit to Canada, he realized studying English was worthwhile.

sections.title: Exercise 1 - Part A: Choose the right word for the given definition.

questions.content: a formal inspection
questions.explanation: a formal inspection (sự kiểm tra chính thức) đồng nghĩa với review (sự xem xét lại).

questions.content: to accept the truth
questions.explanation: to accept the truth (chấp nhận sự thật) đồng nghĩa với concede (thừa nhận).

questions.content: an idea about how something is
questions.explanation: an idea about how something is (một ý tưởng về điều gì đó) đồng nghĩa với concept (khái niệm).

questions.content: knowing a lot about the world
questions.explanation: knowing a lot about the world (biết nhiều về thế giới) đồng nghĩa với sophisticated (sành sỏi, tinh vi).

questions.content: important
questions.explanation: important (quan trọng) đồng nghĩa với worthwhile (đáng giá).

sections.title: Exercise 1 - Part B: Choose the right definition for the given word.

questions.content: particle
questions.explanation: particle: hạt, một mẩu rất nhỏ (a small piece of something).

questions.content: decade
questions.explanation: decade: thập kỷ, mười năm (a period of ten years).

questions.content: upright
questions.explanation: upright: thẳng đứng (standing straight).

questions.content: isolate

sections.title: Exercise 2: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content:
animate / particle
Scientists thought that the tiny _________ was not a living thing, so they were very surprised to find that it was indeed _________.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh: the tiny particle (hạt rất nhỏ), living thing (vật sống) -> animate (có sự sống).

questions.content:
handy / numerous
My uncle, the carpenter, keeps _________ tools in his truck. However, he keeps the most _________ ones on his tool belt at all times.
questions.explanation: numerous tools (nhiều công cụ); the most handy ones (những công cụ tiện lợi nhất).

questions.content:
classify / upright
One way that scientists _________ the different species of early humans is by how they walked. Homo Erectus, for example, walked _________.
questions.explanation: classify the different species (phân loại các loài); walked upright (đi thẳng đứng).

questions.content:
longing / plea
After sitting in the cell for just one hour, the prisoner felt a _________ to be free. He made a _________ to the officers to release him immediately.
questions.explanation: felt a longing (cảm thấy khao khát); made a plea (đưa ra lời cầu xin).

questions.content:
sophisticated / worthwhile
Learning how to speak another language is a _________ skill to have in the world of international business. It also can make one into a more _________ person.
questions.explanation: a worthwhile skill (một kỹ năng đáng giá); a more sophisticated person (một người sành sỏi / tinh tế hơn).

questions.content:
review / concept
Jack had a great _________ for a new system, but his boss needs to conduct a thorough _________ to see if it will work.
questions.explanation: a great concept (một khái niệm/ý tưởng tuyệt vời); conduct a thorough review (tiến hành đánh giá kỹ lưỡng).

questions.content:
diagram / isolate
William used a piece of white paper to _________ the different plants in the garden. That made it easier for him to draw a _________ of the leaves of each type of plant.
questions.explanation: to isolate the different plants (cách ly / tách các loại cây khác nhau); draw a diagram (vẽ một biểu đồ / sơ đồ).

questions.content:
constructed / decades
The great pyramids of Egypt were not _________ overnight. In fact, it took many _________ to complete them.
questions.explanation: constructed overnight (được xây dựng qua đêm); many decades (nhiều thập kỷ).

questions.content:
concede / ferry
As he drove his car onto the _________, John felt sad. He wanted to travel by airplane, but after looking at ticket prices, he had to _________ that air travel was just too expensive.
questions.explanation: onto the ferry (lên phà); had to concede (phải thừa nhận).

questions.content:
refrain / surrender
In maintaining good health, it is important to _________ from eating unhealthy foods. But that doesn't mean you must _________ all of the foods that you enjoy.
questions.explanation: refrain from (kiềm chế, tránh); surrender (từ bỏ).

Anton’s Great Discovery
Anton Van Leeuwenhoek was a Dutch cloth merchant. His life began to change after
he got his first microscope in 1653. It was a very simple microscope. It had a lens in an
upright stand. It could make small things look large. It was handy for looking closely at
cloth.
Soon, Anton felt a longing to build a more powerful microscope. He dreamed of
using it to make an important scientific discovery. He wanted to become famous. Three
decades later, he did.
For many years, Anton experimented with microscopes and lenses. Eventually he
constructed a very powerful microscope. If he had sold the concept to others, it would
have made him very rich. However, Anton refrained from surrendering his secret
to anyone. Instead, he wanted to use it to become famous. So he used his secret
microscope to study the natural world.
One day he was looking at saliva from his mouth with the microscope. In the saliva,
he saw numerous tiny particles. Some of them were moving! He thought that the
particles were tiny organisms. So he isolated them from each other and studied each
one carefully. Then he classified them into different categories. Some
were round. Others were long and had tails. All were alive.
Anton was so excited. He knew he could become famous
now. He was the first person to see these tiny organisms. So
he drew diagrams of the organisms and sent them to a group
of scientists in London. The scientists were sophisticated men
who did not believe tiny, animate organisms could live in our
mouths. Anton made a plea for them to come to Holland to
see the organisms with their own eyes. The men took a ferry
to Holland and met Anton. They performed a careful review of
his work, and they conceded that he had made a
worthwhile discovery. Anton Van Leeuwenhoek
had discovered bacteria. After decades of
hard work, he had become famous.
■
■

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement T for true or F for false. Rewrite the false statements to make them true.

questions.content: Anton's first microscope had an upright stand.
questions.explanation: Thông tin trong bài: 'It had a lens in an upright stand.'

questions.content: Anton had a longing to become rich.
questions.explanation: Sửa lại: Anton had a longing to become famous. (Thông tin trong bài: 'Soon, Anton felt a longing to build a more powerful microscope... He wanted to become famous.')

questions.content: The tiny particles Anton saw were bacteria.
questions.explanation: Thông tin trong bài: 'Anton Van Leeuwenhoek had discovered bacteria.'

questions.content: Anton classified the particles into different categories.
questions.explanation: Thông tin trong bài: 'Then he classified them into different categories.'

questions.content: The sophisticated scientists drew diagrams of the bacteria.
questions.explanation: Sửa lại: Anton drew diagrams of the bacteria. (Thông tin trong bài: 'So he drew diagrams of the organisms and sent them to a group of scientists...')

questions.content: Anton took a ferry to Holland.
questions.explanation: Sửa lại: The scientists took a ferry to Holland. (Thông tin trong bài: 'The men took a ferry to Holland and met Anton.')

questions.content: Which is true about Anton's discovery?
options: It isolated him from his work.
It was handy for his business.
It took him three decades to make it.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn 2: 'He wanted to become famous. Three decades later, he did.'

questions.content: Why was Anton's first microscope handy?
options: It helped him look at cloth.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn 1: 'It was handy for looking closely at cloth.'

questions.content: What was Anton's plea to the scientists?
options: To see the particles with their own eyes
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn cuối: 'Anton made a plea for them to come to Holland to see the organisms with their own eyes.'

questions.content: Why didn't Anton sell his concept of a powerful microscope?
options: He didn't want to surrender his secret.
Scientists needed to review it first.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn 3: 'However, Anton refrained from surrendering his secret to anyone. Instead, he wanted to use it to become famous.'
